notes: «وحدثناه» is a verb with the saying as object, not a back reference: the chain is read from يحيى بن يحيى
«ثم ذكر بمثل حديث ابن علية» names a different transmitter for the same saying (rule 4), but the text gives no route for him, so no variant group is written; ruling needed
«قال كتب إلى» is a letter: Ayyub's transmission from يعلى
